title: Eric Luny
summary: The Canadian questioner of the July 2020 Earth Planetary Council session, whose questions draw out Unimetrix 1's statement of the two-way relationship between eras.
markdown:
**Eric Luny** introduces himself with the record's plain courtesy — *"Yes, UniMetrix,
this is Eric Luny, from Canada"* — and carries seventeen turns across the July 8, 2020
session that bears his name in its title: the negotiation with the
[Earth Planetary Council](/lore/earth-planetary-council/) over [Ori's](/lore/ori/) return
home.

His questions in that session cut straight at the record's geopolitics — *"Greetings.
Does China control the entire Planet?"* — and one of them, Eric's pressing
(*"I understand. Very interesting: so, the battle is not over…?"*), draws out Unimetrix 1's
fullest statement of the two-way relationship between eras — *"We are the future
perspective of you, how you see yourself. You are the past perspective of us"* — the
passage the record's whole stance rests on, answered to Eric Luny.
